'''Tait Ransom''' was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who was the rival of [[Kaine Paulsen]].

==Biography==
Tait Ransom left [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]] many years before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], because he hoped to make a name for himself outside the shadow of [[Kaine Paulsen]]. He later rescued [[Drake Paulsen]] and his mentor, [[Karl Mathieu Ancher]] from the jail on [[Omman Minor]], but he was arrested in the process and sent to [[Vizcarra]]. Drake and his companions managed to free Tait before he was carried off to prison.
